why_this_instrument_exists: Direction v56 names AUDIT STARVATION, not a missing measurement, as this lane's blocker: producer steps die and the audit job (gated on needs.team.result == 'success') never runs. Every previously recorded diagnosis of that class (orchestration_diagnosis_39064497606.json F4, 39076123103, 39072968899, 39092033997) established the POST_DELIVERY variant - the producer wrote a complete durable delta and was killed at ~2703-2704 s before exit 0. Run 39134286491 is a DIFFERENT measured class: its producer step consumed the whole 2704 s quantum and the workflow's own 'Persist team snapshot' step (git switch -C / git add -A / git commit || true / git push --force, core-lane.yml:146-161), which SUCCEEDED at 14:49:31Z, left BOTH refs cycle/core/evaluation/39134286491/team and .../team-attempt-1 at 904aff83, which is byte-identical to the accepted lane head. That is a ZERO-DELTA quantum death. If the two classes are conflated, the control-plane remedy (finish and exit 0) is aimed at the wrong half of the population. This ledger measures how many dispatches of each class occurred; it never re-measures a frozen bar and never adjudicates any packet.
hypothesis_H1: Among the frozen evaluation dispatch population, the producer step's outcome is not a single class: at least one dispatch died at the work quantum with a NON-EMPTY persisted delta (post-delivery) and at least one died at the work quantum with an EMPTY persisted delta (zero-delta), and the audit job ran for none of the quantum deaths.

definitions_frozen.producer_step: core-lane.yml team job step 6, named 'Run lane cycle'.
definitions_frozen.producer_commit_present: the persisted team ref's head commit message begins with 'evaluation cycle <run_id>' (core-lane.yml:159 writes exactly that subject). A head commit whose message is instead an 'accept evaluation cycle <other_run>' commit means the persist step's 'git add -A' found nothing to commit and 'git commit ... || true' was a no-op, i.e. the persisted snapshot carries ZERO delta over the lane base it was built from.
definitions_frozen.persisted_delta_files: the file list of the producer commit when one exists (GET /repos/{o}/{r}/commits/{sha}); [] when it does not.
definitions_frozen.audit_ran: the 'audit' job of the run has status 'completed' (not 'skipped').

classification.OTHER_FAILURE: step 6 failed for a reason other than the quantum duration

success_rule_frozen.rule: H1 is SUPPORTED iff at least one run classifies as POST_DELIVERY_QUANTUM_DEATH AND at least one classifies as ZERO_DELTA_QUANTUM_DEATH AND every quantum_death run has audit_ran == false.
success_rule_frozen.on_support: the two classes must be reported SEPARATELY in the report and in state; the previously published post-delivery-only narrative is then shown to be incomplete, and the control-plane hardening item is stated for the zero-delta half (which the 'finish and exit 0' remedy does not address).
success_rule_frozen.on_refutation: report H1 REFUTED and keep the prior post-delivery-only account; do not relabel anything.
success_rule_frozen.what_this_never_does: it never edits a rubric, threshold, bar, benchmark, baseline, success rule, packet or frozen file; it never adjudicates a packet; it never changes human_gate_ready; it never accepts or rejects a Frontier verdict; it does not certify that a product is correct. No number here may be moved to a higher evidence tier than MEASURED-OPERATIONS.

what_would_falsify_this_hypothesis_besid: If the REST commit endpoint were rate-limited or partially unavailable, per-run classification could be inferred from a missing response rather than measured; the instrument must therefore record, per run, whether each fact was MEASURED or UNAVAILABLE, and must NOT classify a run whose producer_commit fact is UNAVAILABLE.
